product_overview: AI Data Analyst Agent is a local-first analytics web app that lets users upload datasets or connect PostgreSQL, then ask natural-language questions to receive validated analysis, SQL/Python-driven insights, and interactive visualizations. It is designed to feel like a modern SaaS analytics product while keeping analysis deterministic and inspectable.
core_goals: Upload CSV/XLSX datasets and immediately inspect their profile.
Connect to PostgreSQL and register a live table as an analysis dataset.
Ask natural-language analytical questions and receive answers with supporting analysis.
View interactive visualizations generated from safe predefined chart configurations.
Review, reopen, and manage past analyses from a history log.
Configure authentication and connection settings from the app.

features.name: Landing Page Experience
features.description: Introduces the product and lets users begin analysis from the public homepage.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review product overview and feature highlights -> Start analyzing from the primary call to action -> Enter the analysis workspace
Navigate to / -> Review the demo and supporting product sections -> Continue into the product experience

features.name: Dataset Upload & Profiling
features.description: Lets users upload CSV or XLSX files and inspect dataset quality, schema, and preview information.
user_flows: Navigate to /explorer -> Upload a CSV or XLSX file -> View the dataset profile summary -> Inspect quality score, column statistics, and preview rows
Navigate to /explorer -> Browse for a local file -> Upload the selected dataset -> Review detected columns, missing rates, cardinality, and data types
Navigate to /explorer -> Upload an invalid or unsupported file type -> Observe validation feedback -> Choose a valid CSV or XLSX file and upload again

features.name: AI Data Analysis Workspace
features.description: Allows users to ask natural-language questions and receive analytical answers, insights, supporting data, and execution details.
user_flows: Navigate to /workspace -> Choose a suggested question or type a custom question -> Submit the analysis request -> Review the direct answer, key insights, and progress updates
Navigate to /workspace -> Enter a custom analytical question -> Observe the system inspect the dataset and run analysis -> Review the returned SQL or Python-based result details
Navigate to /workspace -> Open expandable analysis details -> Inspect the supporting data, SQL view, and analysis metrics -> Return to the main answer

features.name: Interactive Visualizations
features.description: Displays safe predefined Plotly charts that users can explore and export.
user_flows: Navigate to /workspace -> Trigger an analysis that returns a visualization -> Hover over chart data points -> Zoom or pan the chart -> Reset the chart view
Navigate to /workspace -> Review a rendered chart -> Download the chart image from the chart controls -> Keep the exported visualization for later use

features.name: Analysis History Management
features.description: Lets users search prior analyses, reopen them in the workspace, and remove entries from the audit log.
user_flows: Navigate to /history -> Search previous analyses by text -> Review matching history entries -> Reopen a selected analysis in the workspace
Navigate to /history -> Filter the history by dataset or analysis type -> Inspect past answers and timestamps -> Delete an entry from the history log
Navigate to /history -> Open a historical analysis -> Return to the workspace with the prior query loaded -> Continue exploring the dataset

features.name: Settings and Account Management
features.description: Provides account access, session management, and connector configuration from a single settings page.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Enter username or email and password -> Register or log in -> View the authenticated profile badge
Navigate to /settings -> Sign out of the account -> Return to the unauthenticated state
Navigate to /settings -> Review connector and authentication configuration options -> Update local application preferences

features.name: PostgreSQL Live Connector
features.description: Allows users to test a PostgreSQL connection, discover schemas and tables, and register a table for analysis.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Enter database host, port, name, username, and password -> Test the connection -> Review discovered schemas and tables -> Register a selected table as the active dataset
Navigate to /settings -> Provide PostgreSQL credentials -> Discover available database objects -> Choose a table for analysis and register it
Navigate to /settings -> Attempt a connection with incomplete details -> Observe the validation feedback -> Correct the connection information and test again

tech_stack: Tailwind CSS / Vanilla CSS Design Tokens

routes.description: Modern hero landing page with features showcase, CTA, and metrics
3-column AI Data Analytics Workspace with dynamic prompts, SQL/Python analytics, and interactive charts
Deep dataset profiling explorer with summary statistics, column distributions, and quality health score
Complete audit history log of previous queries, key insights, and 1-click reopen to workspace
User authentication, JWT security tokens, NVIDIA NIM API config, and PostgreSQL data connector

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Register, login, manage JWT session tokens, and sign out
user_interactions: Fill username/email field
Fill password field
Click Login or Register button
View authenticated user profile badge
Click Sign Out

features.name: Dataset Upload & Profiling
features.description: Upload CSV or XLSX files, auto-profile schema, data quality, and preview rows
user_interactions: Drag and drop CSV or Excel file onto upload zone
Click to browse file from local disk
View data quality score badge (e.g., 100% clean)
Explore columns with missing rates, cardinality, data types, and min/max

features.name: AI Data Analyst Chat & Tool Execution
features.description: Multi-turn natural language analytical inquiry with autonomous tool execution (DuckDB SQL and Python engine)
user_interactions: Click dynamic dataset suggested questions
Type custom analytical query into chat input
Observe step-by-step reasoning and tool badge (DuckDB SQL / Python Analytics)
Inspect Direct Answer and Key Insights
Toggle expandable tabs for View SQL, View Data, and Analysis Metrics
Export results as CSV or copy SQL to clipboard

features.name: Predefined Interactive Visualizations
features.description: Interactive Plotly.js charts (Bar, Line, Pie, Scatter, Histogram, Area, KPI) generated safely without LLM code execution
user_interactions: Hover over data points in Plotly chart
Zoom, pan, and reset chart axes
Download chart image via Plotly modebar

features.name: Analysis History Management
features.description: Browse historical queries, search by query or answer text, reopen in workspace, and delete
user_interactions: Search previous queries in search bar
Filter by dataset or analysis type
Click Reopen Analysis to load into Workspace
Click Delete to remove from history audit log

features.name: PostgreSQL Live Connector
features.description: Test and connect to live PostgreSQL database, discover schemas, tables, and columns
user_interactions: Fill host, port, database, username, and password
Click Test Connection
View discovered schemas and tables
Register selected table as active dataset
